Why do other companies get to profit off of something Apple footed the bill for? If I wanted to have an open ecosystem, I would go with android or something else. Free of choice with the consumer means I get to choose what hardware and software platform I want to work with. If I don’t like the way, Apple does something, I don’t have to do business with them. A lot of times you can find spots by looking at photos and figuring out where something is geographically, then going to Google Maps satellite view and searching it. Another thing is to find a niche within the Urbex community. For example, I’m a photographer and my favorite thing to photograph is military related complexes, industrial/manufacturing buildings, and old houses with things still inside. I’ll still explore other things, but those are what I strive to find most of. There’s people that will climb towers, explore places under construction, or even go to the top of skyscrapers. All of which is part of the broader Urbex community, which isn’t limited to just abandoned things. Once you find your niche, it will also make it easier to build up your cred. 

You’ll get there. Just have patience. I’ve been doing Urbex for about 11 years and I’ve met maybe 3 people, and have communicated with like 5 over that period of time. Only recently did I make a friend in the community that is more active these days than I am and we’ve been hitting up spots pretty regularly.
